newsitem.title: USA: High Plains Wheat - Some Kansas mills roll to May.
newsitem.headline: High Plains Wheat - Some Kansas mills roll to May.

text.p: Some Kansas flour mills rolled their basis bids from March to May, grain merchandisers said Wednesday.

A Topeka, Kan. mill went from bidding 35 cents per bushel over the KCBT March contract to 65 cents over the May. Dealers said the move came late Tuesday amid jitters over the widening KCBT March/May spread.
Meanwhile, Kansas dealers noted a flurry of movement Tuesday afternoon in response to the 9-1/2 cent rally in KCBT March wheat.
"We saw a lot of farmer selling yesterday. I'd say we bought between 150,000 and 200,000 bushels," a central Kansas dealer said. "That's not a bad day."
Many dealers pulled their basis bids back by three to five cents because of the surge in futures prices.
Basis values in cents/bu against KCBT wheat, cash=dollars/bu.
(Note: H=KCBT March wheat futures. K=KCBT May wheat futures unq=unquoted, na=not applicable)
